Definition: from G303 and G994; to halloo:--cry (aloud, out).
BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, and it is the cry from the cross: about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, 'Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani' — My God, My God, why hast thou forsaken me. It is not a quiet prayer — it is a shout, the loudest cry in the whole Bible, and it comes from the Son Himself.
TheologicalSignificance: One loud cry carries more weight than a thousand sermons: the Son of God, forsaken, crying out to His Father — and that cry is what makes it possible for us never to be forsaken.
